name: The Jokesters Performance Budget
description: Performance thresholds for automated CI/CD guardrails

ci.note: Headless/limited GPU environment - more lenient thresholds

fps.description: Minimum acceptable frames per second during 5-minute improv scene

memoryLeak.description: Maximum allowed JavaScript heap growth during 5-minute session

ttsLatency.description: Text-to-speech latency from text input to audio buffer ready

bundleSize.description: Total gzipped JavaScript in dist/assets (all chunks, including the MLC worker). Enforced by scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs.
bundleSize.initialDescription: Gzipped JS needed before first paint: the index.html entry script plus its static import graph and modulepreloads. Engine runtimes (web-llm, wllama, transformers.js) must stay out of it.
bundleSize.chunkDescription: Largest single gzipped chunk. Catches accidental chunk merges (e.g. manualChunks swallowing per-mode lazy modules).

firstContentfulPaint.description: Time to first meaningful content render

timeToInteractive.description: Time until main thread is idle and input can be handled

distSize.description: Total size of dist/ (all files). Guards against re-shipping unused onnxruntime-web wasm variants or model binaries from public/.
